# `oaap connector`

the inner side of a tunnel: dial out, offer backends by name (oaap.net.connector 0.1).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap connector {list,show,add,remove,set-key,pause,resume,log,offer,expose,unexpose,extend} [name] [second] [third] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `name` | the connector label; offer: add\|remove |
| `second` | offer: the connector label; expose: the target URL; unexpose/extend: the exposure |
| `third` | offer: the offer name |
| `--endpoint ENDPOINT` | add: the outer node, https://<host> |
| `--plain` | add: accept an http:// endpoint (LAN rehearsal only) |
| `--key-stdin` | add/set-key: read the connect key from standard input |
| `--to TO` | offer add: the backend, http(s)://host[:port][/base] |
| `--path PATH` | offer add: only paths below this prefix |
| `--methods METHODS` | offer add: only these methods, e.g. GET,POST |
| `--ttl TTL` | expose/extend: how long, 30m, 8h, 2d (default 8h, at most 7d) |
| `--public` | expose: no login for visitors (braked, still expires) |
| `-n, --lines LINES` | log: how many calls (default `30`) |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `list` | yes |
| `show` | yes |
| `add` | yes |
| `remove` | yes |
| `set-key` | yes |
| `pause` | yes |
| `resume` | yes |
| `log` | yes |
| `offer` | yes |
| `expose` | yes |
| `unexpose` | yes |
| `extend` | yes |
